title: BBQ party
text:
Four beavers are at a BBQ. They are looking at the food and picking which type of skewer they want.

	
	
	

I need 	I can't eat	As much  as possible	As much  as possible


Task 

There are four skewers. Give one to each beaver so that they are all happy with the skewer they get.

Drag a line between the beavers and the skewers to connect them. Press save when done.

title: Ricca cards
text:
Beaver Barbara collects monster cards called "Riccas". Each monster is different and the card shows their name, the number of eyes they have, and whether or not they have ears. These properties are shown under the picture of each monster. 

Each value of an attribute is noted in a specific way:

Attribute	Type of value

	Values are given as text

	Values are given as  or 

	Values are given as numbers

Task

Four more monster cards are shown below. Select the card that uses the correct type of data for each property.

title: Organising bracelets
text:
Beaver Viktoria keeps her bracelets in a box with seven patterned trays. She stores each bracelet in a tray with a matching colour pattern.

Here is an example of a bracelet with a colour pattern that matches one of the trays.

Task

Choose the bracelet that does not match any of the trays?

title: Spinning shamrocks
text:
Beaver Séamus picked a shamrock but dropped it on the ground. Now it is mixed up with all the other shamrocks! This is a picture of Séamus’ shamrock.

Task

Choose Séamus’s shamrock from the four options below.
You can spin the shamrock by dragging the slider. 
Click on the correct shamrock to select it, then press save.

title: Lost
text:
Beaver Alia is walking in the forest. On her walk, she sees these things:

First, she sees a group of red and yellow flowers.	

Then, she sees an apple tree.	

Last, she sees a bird's nest in a tree.	

Task

Alia is now lost in the middle of the forest. Click on the path that Alia must use to get back to where she started from.
Click save when you are done.
interactionHint: Select the path Alia should take home.

title: Birthday present
text:
Fiona wants a ball for her birthday.

She wants the ball to have a star on it. 

She does not want the ball to have a moon or stripes on it.

Task

 Click on the ball we should buy for Fiona.

title: Oliver's rattle
text:
Oliver has a see-through rattle with colourful balls inside it. When he shakes it, some balls may move around the rattle to the other side. 

In the picture below, you can see that the red ball and the yellow ball moved when the rattle was shaken.

 

Oliver shakes the rattle again and two more balls move.
What does the rattle look like now?

Task

Drag the balls to the correct position in the rattle.
Click save when you are done.

title: Drawing a sailboat
text:
Beaver Sophie wants to trace a drawing of a sailboat.

Sophie must follow these rules:

Tracing can start at any dot in the drawing.

The drawing must be traced in one go. Sophie must never lift the pencil.

A line may only be traced over once. Tracing over the same line again is not permitted.

 

Task

Click on the dot where Sophie should start.

Click save when you are done.

title: Colouring page
text:
Beaver Bea has painted a picture using five different paint colours. She started with five full bottles of paint. When Bea finished, the bottles contained this much paint:

				
Beaver	Sun	Flower	Grass	Sky

Task

Bea used more paint for the large areas of colour in the picture than for small areas. Click on the picture that Bea painted.

text:

If another ball is pushed into the tube when it is full, a ball falls out the other side. In the pictures below you can see what happens when another ball is pushed into the tube:

title: Miracle flower
text:
The miracle flower is a special kind of flower which grows very quickly.

At the start of day 1, it has a single bud.
By the end of day 1, a stalk with two new buds has grown from the initial bud.
On day 2, the process repeats: by the end of the day, a stalk with two new buds grows from each bud that developed the previous day.
This process continues day after day, with each bud from the previous day growing into a new stalk with two new buds by the end of the day.

As a result, the miracle flower becomes taller and more magnificent with each passing day.

Start of Day 1	End of Day 1	End of Day 2

	
	

 

After a number of days, the miracle flower looks like this:

Task

Calculate how many days this miracle flower took to grow.

Type a whole number and click save.

title: Robot path
text:
Beaver Tom’s robot moves by following a set of rules:

The robot starts on the orange tile.

The robot moves in the direction of the arrow on the tile it is standing on.

If the robot moves off the tiles, it stops.

The tiles are arranged as shown below. 

Task

Tom is given three new tiles. Help Tom place the new tiles so the robot can reach the green tile. 

Drag each new tile into an empty space within the grid.

Click save when you have finished.

title: Online class
text:
Ava starts at a new school but keeps in touch with friends from her old school in an online call. 

The friends at the old school are sitting next to each other in a row, but at different computers.

This is how Ava sees her friends on her screen:

Task

Order Ava's friends to show how they are seated in the row by dragging each into the correct position.

Press save when you have finished

title: Free parking spaces
text:
Beaver Tom helps park boats in a water park. He needs to find empty spaces for a boat that wants to stay for two days in a row over the weekend (Friday, Saturday, or Sunday).

Below is a picture showing where boats are already booked on those days.

Friday	Saturday	Sunday
		

Task

Select the spaces from those that are not already booked which will be empty for at least two days in a row.


Click on the numbers of the spaces to select them. Once you are done, click save.
